# elefox studio

> elefox studio builds custom tools that small businesses run on: CRMs, client
> portals, booking systems, and the automations behind the scenes, shaped around
> how a business actually works instead of forcing it into off-the-shelf software.
> We also build the websites that tie into those tools, and handle brand and
> social as supporting work. Based in Coral Springs, FL. Founded by Tiffany Russell.

## Services
- [Custom software](https://elefoxstudio.com/services/software): Custom CRMs, client portals, booking systems, internal tools and dashboards. Build from $3,500, hosting from $50/mo, no per-seat fees.
- [Websites](https://elefoxstudio.com/services/websites): Conversion-focused websites that tie into your tools, with real SEO and accessible markup.
- [Brand & marketing](https://elefoxstudio.com/services/brand): Brand kits, social systems, and marketing infrastructure.
- [AI & automation](https://elefoxstudio.com/services/ai): Practical automation and AI agents wired into your workflow where they earn their keep.

## Landing pages
- [Custom CRM](https://elefoxstudio.com/custom-crm): A custom CRM built around how your business actually works.
- [CRM for realtors](https://elefoxstudio.com/crm-for-realtors): A custom CRM built for how real estate actually works.
- [CRM for contractors](https://elefoxstudio.com/crm-for-contractors): A custom CRM for estimates, jobs, scheduling, and invoices.

## Key facts
- What we build: custom CRMs, client portals, booking systems, automations, websites
- Who it's for: small businesses, realtors, contractors, advisors, therapists, small teams
- Pricing: builds from $3,500, hosting from $50/mo, no per-seat fees, live in 4 to 6 weeks
- You own the software; we host and support it
- Location: Coral Springs, FL, United States
- Contact: hello@elefoxstudio.com, 954.780.6508
